components.css: .ds-holo { position: relative; width: 225px; aspect-ratio: 5 / 7; border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: #23252b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 11px rgba(255, 128, 0, 0.1); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-holo:hover { transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(-7deg); } .ds-holo-foil { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.1; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 25%, oklch(0.774 0.163 60.276) 40%, oklch(0.709 0.159 293.541) 50%, oklch(0.797 0.134 211.502) 60%, transparent 75%); background-size: 350% 350%; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-holo:hover .ds-holo-foil { opacity: 0.25; } .ds-holo-content { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--raw-space-8); padding: var(--raw-space-24); font-family: var(--font--mono), monospace; font-size: var(--raw-text-xs); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-holo-level { color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-holo-name { font-family: var(--font-logo), sans-serif; font-size: var(--raw-text-lg); letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

narrative.overview:
The engineer is the collectible. Everything sits on dark matte card stock, Midnight Console, with one warm accent, Forge Orange, struck sparingly like the printed border of a trading card. The shine is rare and earned: foil, glare and glow appear only when light hits (on hover, on tilt, on scroll) and settle back to a faint trace at rest. The signature object is literal: the profile is a 5:7 trading card with stat rows, an ability box, an iridescent foil and a λ texture that nods to functional programming.

The system is precision-engineered minimalism, dark and warm, playful only in the details. Layout is calm and generous, built on an 8px grid; type is a technical pairing of a geometric display face, a neutral sans for reading and a monospace for every piece of metadata. Density is low: one idea per section, short copy, wide gutters. Play lives in small, deliberate moments (the holo card, sparkles, the drifting ambient glow behind the page), never in the structure.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: one theme, a Midnight Console base with tonal raises, no light mode.
One accent: Forge Orange carries every interactive and emphasis signal.
Light as interaction: glow, halo and foil respond to the visitor, then rest.
Monospace metadata: dates, tags, badges, stats and tech lists read like instrument readouts.
One collectible: the holo profile card is the system's single showpiece.

rules.name: The One Forge Rule
rules.body: Forge Orange is the only accent. No second brand hue competes with it; status colors live inside callouts and nowhere else, and the ambient hues exist only as blurred light behind the page.

rules.name: The Small-Text Rule
rules.body: Orange text below 18px on an orange-tinted surface uses Forge Orange Text, not Forge Orange.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Metadata is monospace. Dates, tags, badges, years, stats and tech names set in JetBrains Mono; narrative copy never does.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a drop shadow. Surfaces answer interaction with light (halo, outline, glow, foil), never by floating upward.

dos: **Do** keep every surface on Midnight Console or one tonal step from it (Console Raised, Console Deep, 30% black wells).
**Do** express interaction with light: the Halo on buttons, the Outline glow on cards, the text glow on links.
**Do** set metadata in JetBrains Mono, narrative copy in Inter, and names and headlines in Space Grotesk.
**Do** use Forge Orange Text for small orange text on orange-tinted surfaces.
**Do** keep reading text at 1.65 line height and prose columns at 680px.
**Do** reference tokens (`--color-*`, `--radius-*`, `--space-*`) instead of literal values; OG cards are the only exception.
**Do** hide or still ambient motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second accent color; status hues stay inside callouts.
**Don't** add drop shadows that lift surfaces; depth is tonal, shine is light.
**Don't** run foil, glare or glow at full strength at rest; at most a faint trace (the foil's 10%), with the shine earned on interaction.
**Don't** add a second collectible showpiece; the holo profile card is the one.
**Don't** set narrative copy in monospace or metadata in the body face.
